name: Rosh
title: Son of Benjamin
summary: Rosh was one of the sons of Benjamin, Jacob's youngest son. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis as part of Jacob's family that went down to Egypt. As a member of the tribe of Benjamin, he is part of the broader patriarchal history of Israel's twelve tribes.

keyEvents.title: Listed in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Roš is mentioned as one of Benjamin's ten sons in the genealogy in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Family Travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: As part of Jacob's extended family, Roš was among the seventy people who went down to Egypt during the famine.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Descendants in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Benjamin's lineage, including his sons, is documented in Chronicles as part of Israel's tribal history.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing over Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jacob blessed his youngest son Benjamin before his death, which also affected Benjamin's descendants, including Roš.
